name: Inverse Mesh Recovery with Spatiotemporal Bilateral Gradient Filtering
aliases: Edge-aware cross-bilateral filter for mesh recovery
definition: An inverse rendering technique that recovers a mesh geometry from multi-view images by optimizing vertex positions. It uses a spatiotemporal bilateral filter to smooth gradients, preserving sharp edges and silhouettes better than Laplacian smoothing, leading to faster convergence on thin structures.
summary: Inverse Mesh Recovery with Spatiotemporal Bilateral Gradient Filtering is a gradient-based optimization technique that recovers mesh geometry from multi-view images by replacing Laplacian smoothing with an edge-aware cross-bilateral filter to preserve sharp features and accelerate convergence.
